title: BiCC: Bidirectional Connected-Component Loss for Instance-Aware Segmentation
mechanism: DiceCE on Voronoi cells of each GT component plus a branch on Voronoi cells of predicted components that penalises pure false-positive components with a size-independent mass score; alpha trades lesion precision vs recall.
adaptation: 2D 8-connectivity on merged crack instances and inactive components; GT Voronoi cells precomputed in the loader, prediction cells per step via GPU connected components on 8 x 512 px. Replaces soft Dice on crack/inactive; CE on 24 classes kept. FP branch penalises decoys (scuff streaks, gridline look-alikes) per component.
min_experiment: Arms: alpha 0 (CC-DiceCE) and 0.5, 5 seeds each vs house 5 seeds. Metrics: component F1 on merged instances (test clean-49, E1), relF1@2, crack and inactive IoU. Kill: component F1 not above house by 0.02 on both sets.
evidence: 5 datasets (AutoPET III, ISLES, BraTS-METS, LiTS, CMB), 5-fold nnU-Net: lesion F1 significantly above DiceCE on 3, tie on 2; CC-DiceCE loses up to 0.363 precision; post-hoc thresholding of DiceCE cannot reproduce the alpha sweep; +17-23% training time on A6000.
prior_overlap: Global logit bias was tried (ensemble); BiCC shows threshold shifts cannot reproduce its precision-recall shift. No component-wise loss run.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack: GT branch for small missed cracks, prediction branch for decoys (scuff streaks on half-cut E1 cells, busbar edges); alpha tuned on val relP@2/relR@2.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house loss + BiCC on crack, 5 seeds; baseline SUP100 and the CC-DiceCE arm. Metric components found, relP@2, E1 false-alarm components. Kill: components found < +0.02 at relP@2 drop <= 0.02.
